note: Scripted M0 benchmark phrases (D-47: no personal names). Reference transcript = text.

A.title: Session A · Close to the speakerphone
A.where: Sit or stand about an arm's length (0.5–1 m) from the speakerphone.

B.title: Session B · Across the room
B.where: Stand about 3 metres (10 feet) away, on the far side of the room.

C.title: Session C · With background sound
C.where: Stand about 1–2 m away. Play a video or podcast on your phone or laptop at normal volume, about 1 m from the speakerphone.

D.title: Session D · Pippletron (about 3 minutes)
D.where: First 10 lines close to the speakerphone, the rest from across the room. The last 6 do NOT say Pippletron.

E.title: Session E · Claps and other sounds (about 5 minutes)
E.where: For tuning the clap switch (D-91). Each one: press record, make the sound, wait about 2 seconds, press Stop. Sit or stand where you usually are unless it says otherwise. (Pip may switch his listening off if he hears two claps; turn it back on with the button on Pip's dashboard.)

F.title: Session F · Claps on the clap microphone (about 5 minutes)
F.where: Records from the second microphone you chose on Pip's dashboard (Listening & sounds), not the speakerphone. Same as Session E: press record, make the sound, wait about 2 seconds, press Stop. Sit or stand where you usually are unless it says otherwise.
